messages.category.backup.description: Backs up, exports, or restores configuration and download data.
messages.category.convert.description: Converts downloaded content into other formats or structures.
messages.category.database.description: Provides connections for the main database and private plugin storage.
messages.category.dependency.description: These plugins are dependencies of other plugins. They are installed automatically and usually do not need to be installed manually.
messages.category.download-type.description: Extends the downloader with new data sources and download types (we are just a Pixiv downloader, right?)
messages.category.download.description: Enhances existing download workflows, queues, or automation.
messages.category.notify.description: Sends runtime notifications through email, push services, and other channels.
messages.category.security.description: Improves protection for plugins, accounts, or local data.
messages.category.translate.description: Adds translation capabilities for work content or metadata.
messages.category.ui.description: Customizes the themes and experience of the desktop and web interfaces.
messages.category.utility.description: Provides statistics, organization, and other general-purpose tools.
messages.compat.fallback: The latest version, v{latest}, is incompatible with your SDK. Compatible version v{selected} is selected by default.
messages.compat.no-recommendation: No default recommendation. You can select a compatible prerelease in the details.
messages.compat.none: No installable compatible version was found. Update the app and try again.
messages.compat.search-incomplete: The compatible-version search could not finish. Refresh to retry.
messages.content.failed: Content could not be loaded. Please try again.
messages.content.missing-images: Some images could not be loaded. The rest of the document is available.
messages.database.busy: A connection check is already running. Try again shortly.
messages.database.connected: Connection check passed. Settings have not been saved and no data has been migrated.
messages.database.connection-failed: Connection failed: {target} (SQLState {sqlState}). Check the address, account, password and schema.
messages.database.enable-confirm: Fully exit and restart after enabling. Your database selection and existing data will be kept.
messages.database.enabled: Enable setting saved. Fully exit and restart; the database has not been activated.
messages.database.error.authentication: The database username or password is incorrect. Check the username and enter the password again.
messages.database.error.authorization: The database rejected this account or device. Confirm the account can sign in and ask the database administrator to check connection access.
messages.database.error.backup-exists: A file already exists at the backup location. Keep the existing backup and run the check again before starting migration.
messages.database.error.busy: The database or migration is busy. Wait for the current operation to finish, then try again.
messages.database.error.configuration: The connection settings are invalid. Check the address format and options, and enter the username and password in their separate fields.
messages.database.error.connection: Cannot connect to the database. Check the address, port, network, and whether the database service is running.
messages.database.error.data-mismatch: The migrated data did not pass verification, so the database has not been switched. Keep the original database and backups, then run the check again.
messages.database.error.database-missing: The specified database was not found. Check the database name in the connection address and confirm it exists.
messages.database.error.encoding: The database character encoding is not supported. Use an encoding supported by the database plugin.
messages.database.error.file: The database file cannot be opened. Check its location and the read and write permissions of its folder.
messages.database.error.interrupted: Migration was cancelled or interrupted. Keep the original database and backups, then run the check again before continuing.
messages.database.error.overridden: Some database settings are controlled by environment variables or startup arguments. Update or remove those overrides first.
messages.database.error.permission: This account does not have the database permissions needed for this operation. Use an account with the required read and write access.
messages.database.error.plan-changed: The settings, plugins, or data list have changed. Run the check again before confirming.
messages.database.error.private-storage: Plugin data cannot be accessed. Check the database account permissions and plugin status, then try again.
messages.database.error.product: The current database plugin does not support this database type or version. Check the compatibility requirements of the plugin.
messages.database.error.provider-unavailable: The selected database plugin is unavailable. Confirm it is installed and enabled, then restart the application.
messages.database.error.restart: A full application restart is required. Close and reopen the application, then check the database settings.
messages.database.error.schema: The data structure cannot be migrated safely. Confirm the related plugins are installed with compatible versions, then run the check again.
messages.database.error.schema-missing: The specified database schema is unavailable. Check the schema setting in the connection address and the access granted to this account.
messages.database.error.source-changed: The original database changed after the check. Run the check again and confirm the migration.
messages.database.error.source-unavailable: The original database cannot be read; its file may be missing or damaged. Check the original database location and integrity, then try again.
messages.database.error.target-mismatch: The connected database does not match the selected destination. Check the address and run the check again.
messages.database.error.target-not-empty: The destination already contains data and cannot be safely replaced. Choose an empty destination or ask the database administrator to handle the existing data.
messages.database.error.target-read-only: The destination cannot be written to. Check the database account permissions or the write permissions of the destination folder.
messages.database.error.unknown: The operation could not be completed. Check the connection settings and try again. If it still fails, share the diagnostic details with support.
messages.database.error.unsupported: The database does not support this operation. Check compatibility between the database plugin and server.
messages.database.failed: Settings could not be read or checked. Try again.
messages.database.migration.confirm-notice: Confirm to save other settings and restart, then process the data as listed below. The database switches only after all checks pass. Failure retains the original settings and any data already migrated.
messages.database.migration.failed: Migration could not be scheduled. Refresh the results and check the configuration and migration status before retrying.
messages.database.migration.failure: Checks or migration did not complete ({code}). Review each store’s result and check again.
messages.database.migration.phase.connection-repa: The original connection is invalid: repair the connection and restart; existing source data will not be migrated
messages.database.migration.phase.empty-source: Empty source; initialize the target on startup
messages.database.migration.phase.replace-target: Existing target data will be backed up and replaced
messages.database.migration.phase.reuse: Already copied; will verify again before switching.
messages.database.migration.phase.rolled-back: This item was not saved; its writes were undone
messages.database.migration.phase.same-target: Same database; update connection settings only
messages.database.migration.phase.unknown: It is unclear whether this data was saved. Run the check again before continuing.
messages.database.migration.ready: Checks complete. Review how the data will be handled.
messages.database.migration.replacement-notice: Existing target data will be backed up before replacement. Copies are verified before replacing each database. Backups stay in the database migration records folder.
messages.database.migration.status.failed: Migration is incomplete. The original database remains in use. Data already migrated is retained; run the check again before retrying.
messages.database.migration.status.pending: Migration scheduled. Stopping services and restarting.
messages.database.migration.status.running: Migrating and verifying. The application will start automatically.
messages.database.migration.title: Review database change
messages.database.not-created: SQLite file does not exist yet: {target}. The check did not create it.
messages.database.notice: After editing the connection, run a check and review the change. The database switches only after the data is verified.
messages.database.overridden: Higher-priority configuration, such as environment variables or startup arguments, overrides: {keys}
messages.database.password-kept: Password stored; leave blank to keep it
messages.database.redacted: The saved connection could not be validated, so its URL is hidden. Enter it again. A blank password still preserves the stored password.
messages.database.save-failed: Saving has not been confirmed. Your draft is preserved. Refresh the status before trying again.
messages.database.save-invalid: Settings are invalid, or existing plugin private data has not been migrated and verified. Nothing was saved. Check the fields or the migration guide.
messages.database.saved: Settings saved. A full restart is required. The active connection is unchanged.
messages.database.saved-status-unavailable: Configuration saved, but the latest status could not be read. Refresh to check it, then fully exit and restart.
messages.database.stale: The draft changed during the check. Check it again.
messages.database.title: Database selection and connection

messages.detail.no-description: This plugin has no description yet.

messages.error.detail: Cannot load plugin details. Try again later.

messages.error.load: Failed to load the plugin market. Please try again later.

messages.host.elevated.notice: The host is running with elevated privileges; every host-process full-trust plugin will inherit them.
messages.import.confirm: I verified the publisher, every network host, and the full key fingerprints, and trust this repository to distribute executable code.
messages.import.conflict: The repository ID conflicts with an existing or built-in repository and cannot be trusted.
messages.import.description: Enter the public HTTPS URL of repository.json. The app shows the publisher, network hosts, full key fingerprints, and update boundary before changing configuration.
messages.import.executable-warning: Third-party plugins run in the same JVM as the app. There is currently no code sandbox, so installed plugins receive process-level access.
messages.import.saved: Repository trust snapshot saved; restart to apply.
messages.import.title: Add third-party repository
messages.install.dependency.catalog-missing: {id} was not found in the same repository
messages.install.dependency.catalog-version-unsat: No version of {id} in the same repository satisfies {required}
messages.install.preview.boundary: The package declares its lifecycle and may require a full process restart. Stop consumers first if a shared dependency is in use. Each package commits separately: later failures leave successful dependencies installed. Review the result, fix the cause, and preview again.
messages.install.preview.cancelled: Installation cancelled. Previously installed dependencies are retained; review the results.
messages.install.preview.conflict.ambiguous_insta: Multiple installed packages have ID {plugin}. Resolve the conflict in plugin management.
messages.install.preview.conflict.downgrade: The target version of {plugin} is older than the installed version: {details}
messages.install.preview.conflict.missing_depende: The selected repository has no suitable dependency {plugin}: {details}
messages.install.preview.conflict.reverse_depende: The target version of {plugin} does not satisfy installed consumers: {details}
messages.install.preview.conflict.source_conflict: The installed and selected sources for {plugin} differ: {details}. Remove the old package in plugin management first; its data is retained.
messages.install.preview.summary: Review the versions to install and their impact on existing plugins.
messages.install.preview.title: Installation impact
messages.install.preview.unavailable: The confirmation dialog is unavailable. Reload the page and try again.
messages.install.restart-hint: The package was written to disk but could not be activated in this process; confirm its state after restart.
messages.install.state.stored-development: Saved; not loaded in this mode
messages.install.toast.recovery-blocked: The install transaction requires restart recovery.
messages.install.toast.rolled-back: Activation failed; the previous version was restored.
messages.install.trust.confirm: I trust this plugin and allow it to run
messages.install.trust.declarative-risk: This plugin will run in a separate declarative worker. The worker has protocol and resource limits, but it still uses the same OS account as PixivDownloader and is not a complete operating-system sandbox. Install only from sources you trust.
messages.install.trust.elevated-risk: PixivDownloader is currently running with elevated privileges; this full-trust plugin will inherit them.
messages.install.trust.risk: This plugin will run inside the PixivDownloader process with the same local permissions as PixivDownloader. It can access files and networks available to the current user, run background tasks, register local endpoints, and may execute scripts in PixivDownloader pages. Installing a plugin is equivalent to running a local application. Install only from sources you trust.
messages.install.trust.title: Confirm plugin execution trust
messages.install.trust.unsigned-risk: This plugin has no publisher signature. PixivDownloader cannot prove who published it or whether future updates still come from the same author.
messages.installation.advice.dependency: Check whether a dependency is missing, disabled, or failed to start. Resolve that dependency and restart; reinstalling the dependent plugin may be unnecessary.
messages.installation.advice.disabled: If this plugin is needed, enable it in plugin management and restart. Being disabled does not mean its package is damaged.
messages.installation.advice.incompatible: Check the error summary for the local plugin, dependency, and app version requirements. Choose compatible versions; repeatedly installing the same incompatible version will not help.
messages.installation.advice.not-loaded: The package is stored on disk, but no loading result is available. Restart and check plugin management and startup logs. A successful installation does not mean it is active.
messages.installation.advice.not-started: The local plugin was found but is not running. Restart first. If it still does not start, check startup logs, enablement settings, and dependencies.
messages.installation.advice.runtime-different: The stored version differs from the running instance. Restart and check again. If they still differ, check the actual loading path and startup logs instead of repeatedly reinstalling.
messages.installation.advice.runtime-only: The current instance is running, but the disk inventory did not find its package. Check its loading path and logs for a moved or deleted package. The installation button does not indicate whether it is running.
messages.installation.advice.stopped: The plugin has stopped. Restart first. If it stops again, inspect startup logs and dependencies before deciding whether to reinstall.
messages.installation.advice.unknown: The local package cannot currently be confirmed; this does not mean it is absent. Restart and refresh the status. If it remains unknown, check the error summary for directory permissions, locks, and installation transactions.
messages.installation.development: This multi-module development mode loads source build outputs only. Packages are saved to disk but are not loaded, even after restarting in the same mode. Use normal runtime mode with this installation directory; startup checks still apply.
messages.installation.market-facts: The signature, review and revocation details below belong to the selected market package. They do not apply to a local package with different contents.
messages.installation.match.DIFFERENT_ARTIFACT: The local package has the same version but different contents. Market review and signature details do not apply to it. Replacement still requires source and integrity checks.
messages.installation.match.SAME_ARTIFACT: The saved local package matches the selected market package. See local details for its running state.
messages.installation.match.UNKNOWN: Unable to verify whether the local and selected market packages match.
messages.installation.same-version-mismatch: The local and selected market packages have the same version but different SHA-256 hashes. Compare their hashes and sources in Details. Market signatures and reviews do not describe the local package. Different content does not prove corruption; install only if replacement is intended.
messages.installation.state.dependency: Local plugin needs an available dependency
messages.installation.state.stored-development: Stored; not loaded in development mode

messages.operations.hint: Installations already started will continue when you leave this page.
messages.operations.not-started: A query record was created, but installation has not started. Review and confirm a new plan to install.
messages.operations.query-failed: Results are temporarily unavailable. Previous results remain below. Refresh later; do not submit the installation again.
messages.operations.retention: The current process retains up to 64 recent records for at most 24 hours. Leaving this page does not cancel an installation that has started. After expiry or a process restart, check installed state before reviewing a new plan.
messages.operations.running: Operation {id} is still running. Check its progress in install history; do not submit the installation again.
messages.operations.state.stored-development: Saved; not loaded in development mode
messages.operations.title: Install history
messages.operations.unknown: The installation result is not yet known. Refresh install history. If the app restarted or the record expired, check installed plugins before previewing again.

messages.recovery.action-failed: The action failed. Try again or check the logs.
messages.recovery.action-pending: The application is restarting or exiting. Please wait.
messages.recovery.banner.desc: Normal features are paused. Install, repair, or reinstall the plugins listed below, then restart the application.
messages.recovery.banner.title: Recovery mode is active
messages.recovery.confirm-exit: Exiting will end the current process. Continue?
messages.recovery.confirm-restart: Restarting will end the current process and launch the application again. Continue?
messages.recovery.explanation: This is not necessarily a plugin issue, and it is not your fault. Try restarting the application first, then use the error summary to decide whether to reinstall a plugin or send feedback.
messages.recovery.focus-incomplete: Some suggested plugins could not be located in this repository or are not loaded yet. Load more, browse the GUI category, or switch trusted repositories and check the plugin IDs in the error summary. A missing card does not mean the problem is resolved.
messages.recovery.focus.failed: Possible problem · failed to start or run
messages.recovery.local-only: Recovery actions are only available on this computer.
messages.recovery.no-error-details: No specific exception is available. Include the logs from this startup when sending feedback.
messages.recovery.normal-disabled: Recovery actions are disabled in normal mode.
messages.recovery.reason.failed-no-detail: Plugin {pluginId} failed during startup. Check the logs, then repair or reinstall it.
messages.recovery.reason.missing: Required plugin {pluginId} is not installed. Install or repair it first.
messages.recovery.reason.transaction-unknown: Plugin installation transaction recovery is incomplete. Check the logs and restart the application.
messages.recovery.reason.unavailable: Required plugin {pluginId} is unavailable ({status}). Install or repair it.
messages.recovery.reason.unknown: Plugin status is abnormal. Check the logs, then repair or reinstall the affected plugin.
messages.recovery.status-unavailable: Recovery status could not be verified. Actions are disabled.
messages.security.notice: Plugin execution and signatures: host-process full-trust plugins run in the same JVM as the application and inherit its user's operating-system privileges. Declarative plugins use a limited-isolation worker under the same OS account. A signature proves the package publisher and content integrity only; it is not a security review. Install only plugins you trust.
